china_race_dynamics.text: When it comes to AI, we are the world's leader in AI innovation and investment. We need to maintain this. We're in a race against China for leadership in this space. Someone is going to win, and it should be us. We've also got to ensure we protect our kids as they go online and make sure that there are some guardrails so you can't have people committing crimes with AI.
